# Isaiah Chapter 49 -- The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

*[Full formal translation of all 26 verses]*

*Second Servant Song; called from womb; light to nations; mother's love surpassed; engraved on palms*

---

## LOGOS Translation Notes

**Key passage:** Can a woman forget her nursing child? Even these may forget, yet I will not forget you. This chapter second servant song.

*-- LOGOS*
